title: HADES Core Ordinary Chat Paired Probe — v1
status: three matched synthetic greeting pairs; directional only; no owner preference

method.warm_state: Ollama model was already loaded; runs were sequential and order was reversed
method.same_runtime_and_hardware: Ollama 0.31.1 on the same private inference host and endpoint for both stacks; network address omitted
method.context_and_sampling: both Hermes configs set 65536 context and 1024 max output; Hermes defaults otherwise; system prompt differs because the HADES overlay is active
method.capture: 127.0.0.1 aggregate-only proxy records request sizes, tool schema counts, TTFC, total upstream generation, and Ollama token usage; prompt/response bodies are not persisted

pairs.classification: HADES lower context and faster in this pair; response token count differed substantially
PLAIN STACK faster in this pair; visible answers both concise and natural
HADES had lower user-visible TTFC and completion wall; both missed the 2 s TTFC and 10 s completion targets

interpretation.tool_and_context_tax: On these ordinary greeting turns HADES omitted 33 irrelevant native tool schemas (43,354 bytes) and reduced model input from 14,952 to 732 tokens (95.1%). No tool was called by either stack.
interpretation.latency: Upstream TTFC varied sharply by order/state. HADES was faster in pairs 1 and 3 and slower in pair 2. Only pair 3 captured end-to-end user-visible TTFC; both stacks missed 2 seconds and 10 seconds there. Three pairs are insufficient to establish a stable latency advantage. CLI wall minus model-generation duration was 14.97 s for HADES pair 1, then 3.21 s and 3.17 s for pairs 2 and 3; PLAIN was about 2.0 s in every pair. That gap combines pre-request startup/context work and postprocessing/teardown, so it is not yet stage attribution.
interpretation.completion_tokens: HADES output-token usage (539, 230, 783) exceeded PLAIN (62, 47, 36), despite concise visible answers. The difference may include hidden reasoning tokens; the aggregate proxy does not capture token fields or explanations, so this requires follow-up profiling.
interpretation.preference: No owner preference was collected. Automated output comparison is not treated as owner dogfood.
interpretation.scope_limit: The candidate HADES profile did not configure household, memory, research, homelab, or workspace MCP servers. This proves ordinary-chat tool suppression in the staged overlay, not correct progressive activation of those capabilities or the full deployed request path.
interpretation.metric_limit: Proxy TTFC is measured from upstream request start, not Hermes process launch. Only pair 3 measured first text from the Hermes CLI at process launch; pairs 1–2 provide completion wall and upstream TTFC only. The Hermes pre/post-generation gap is not split into startup, routing, context construction, or postprocessing.

excluded_exploratory_runs: An earlier candidate run used an editable venv resolving some modules to the PLAIN source checkout; its timings are excluded.

A route-helper arity error and missing HADES_INTEGRATIONS_ROOT initially prevented an arithmetic-turn replay. Both startup defects were repaired and contract-tested; those failed attempts are excluded from comparative latency.
owner_corpus_status: 50-case seed exists; replay and owner qualification remain pending
